derivation.within_signed_pair: For plus/minus coefficient +/-lambda: Hpair=lambda^2 [A B] [[x^2,-dot^2],[-dot^2,y^2]] [A B]^T, x=A^T A,y=B^T B. Kernel computes its exact PSD square root with only Cauchy roundoff clamp.
derivation.c_h_equivalent: Ignoring global positive factor3: coefficient(cc^T)=8(ab+t^2), coefficient(hh^T)=4(a^2+b^2)+8t^2, coefficient(ch^T+hc^T)=8(a+b)t; a=||c||^2,b=||h||^2,t=c^T h. T120 pairk3 omitted t terms; PCM retained them exactly.
derivation.remaining_omission: Cross-pair terms i,j in different signed pairs; neither column reweighting nor within-pair whitening recovers them.
